edge_grammar.eligible_public_symbol: PascalCase Rust public name beginning uppercase, containing only ASCII alphanumerics, and at least six characters long
edge_grammar.generic_word_law: Plain words, case-folded names, stems, synonyms, headings, comments, and fuzzy similarity create no edge.
edge_grammar.module_law: A module inherits only the exact target union of its direct public-symbol edges, with every contributing public source identity retained.

legacy_obligation.law: An exact TeX symbol occurrence preserves a correspondence candidate only. It does not establish representation equality, preservation, correctness, completeness, or successor standing.

review_law: Every admitted implementation identity is reviewed under exact source incidence. Absence of an admitted exact symbol edge yields ImplementationOnly at Phase A; it does not prove that no future checked correspondence exists.
gate_law: Complete implementation classification closes only FORMAL-A-RUST-SURFACE-INVENTORY. Formal Gate A remains pending until fixture/test classification and all required claim edges are independently checked.
